story_description: As a user setting up Blaze for the first time, I need an intelligent orchestrator that coordinates CLI detection, dependency checking, installation, and state management so that the onboarding flow is seamless and I can recover from errors gracefully.
task_description: Build the CLISetupViewModel ObservableObject that orchestrates the entire CLI detection and installation workflow, managing state transitions, coordinating with CLIInstallationService, and exposing reactive bindings to the SwiftUI views.
atom_description: Implement CLISetupViewModel as an ObservableObject that manages CLI setup state machine transitions, coordinates async detection and installation operations via CLIInstallationService, handles user actions like install/skip/retry, exposes Published properties for view binding, and ensures proper error recovery and cancellation support.
problem_statement: The CLI detection and installation flow requires complex state management across multiple async operations including scanning PATH for binaries, checking versions, installing dependencies, and installing CLIs. Without a dedicated ViewModel to orchestrate this flow, the view layer would contain business logic, state transitions would be error-prone, and testing would be difficult. Users need clear feedback during long-running operations and the ability to cancel or retry failed installations.
scope_in: Implement CLISetupViewModel as MainActor ObservableObject class
Expose Published properties for setupState, detectedCLIs, selectedCLIs, currentProgress, and errors
Implement startScan() method that triggers CLIInstallationService.detectAllCLIs()
Implement installSelected() method that queues and executes CLI installations
Implement installAll() method as convenience for installing all missing CLIs
Implement skip() method to bypass installation and proceed to next onboarding step
Implement cancel() method to abort in-progress installation operations
Implement retry() method to restart failed installations
Manage state machine transitions per CLISetupState enum
Handle dependency resolution before CLI installation
Expose computed properties for canProceed, isInstalling, hasErrors
Integrate with OnboardingStore for navigation state
Emit telemetry events for setup milestones and errors
Support cancellation via Swift Concurrency Task cancellation
scope_out: Actual CLI binary detection logic which lives in CLIInstallationService
UI rendering which lives in OnboardingCLISetupView and InstallationProgressView
Persistence of detected CLI state across app launches
Network layer implementation for downloading binaries
assumptions: CLIInstallationService actor is implemented and provides detectAllCLIs(), install(cli:), and checkDependencies(for:) methods
CLISetupState enum is defined with scanning, detected, installing, complete, skipped, and error cases
CLIDetectionResult struct contains cli type, installed status, version, and path
OnboardingStore exists and provides navigation methods like advanceToNextStep()
Swift Concurrency is available with MainActor for UI state management
The app targets macOS 14.0 or later supporting modern Swift concurrency
constraints: ViewModel must be MainActor to safely update Published properties from async contexts
State transitions must be atomic to prevent race conditions between user actions and async callbacks
Cancellation must properly clean up partial installations to leave system in consistent state
Memory management must avoid retain cycles between ViewModel and closures
Error messages must be user-friendly without exposing internal implementation details
Installation queue must process CLIs sequentially to avoid resource conflicts
functional_requirements: FR1: CLISetupViewModel conforms to ObservableObject protocol for SwiftUI binding
FR2: setupState Published property reflects current CLISetupState enum value
FR3: detectedCLIs Published array contains CLIDetectionResult for each supported CLI
FR4: selectedCLIs Published Set contains CLIType values user has selected for installation
FR5: currentProgress Published optional contains InstallProgress during active installation
FR6: errorMessage Published optional contains user-facing error description when in error state
FR7: startScan() transitions state to scanning then calls service and transitions to detected on completion
FR8: installSelected() validates selection non-empty then transitions to installing and processes queue
FR9: installAll() selects all missing CLIs and calls installSelected()
FR10: skip() transitions state to skipped and advances onboarding navigation
FR11: cancel() cancels active Task and transitions to detected state preserving partial results
FR12: retry() clears error state and re-attempts failed operation based on context
FR13: canProceed computed property returns true when at least one CLI is installed or user skipped
FR14: isInstalling computed property returns true when state is installing case
FR15: hasErrors computed property returns true when state is error case or failed array non-empty
FR16: toggleSelection(cli:) adds or removes CLI from selectedCLIs set
FR17: selectRecommended() populates selectedCLIs with CLIs where isRecommended is true
FR18: State transitions emit telemetry events via AnalyticsService
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: State transitions must complete within 16ms to maintain 60fps UI updates
NFR2: Scan operation must complete within 5 seconds for typical system with 8 CLI candidates
NFR3: Memory footprint must not exceed 10MB during installation queue processing
NFR4: Cancellation must respond within 100ms of user action
NFR5: ViewModel must be testable in isolation via dependency injection of services
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create CLISetupViewModel.swift file in Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/ViewModels directory
Step 2: Declare CLISetupViewModel class with @MainActor and ObservableObject conformance
Step 3: Add @Published var setupState: CLISetupState = .scanning property
Step 4: Add @Published var detectedCLIs: [CLIDetectionResult] = [] property
Step 5: Add @Published var selectedCLIs: Set<CLIType> = [] property
Step 6: Add @Published var currentProgress: InstallProgress? = nil property
Step 7: Add @Published var errorMessage: String? = nil property
Step 8: Add private let installationService: CLIInstallationService dependency
Step 9: Add private let onboardingStore: OnboardingStore dependency
Step 10: Add private let analytics: AnalyticsService dependency
Step 11: Add private var installTask: Task<Void, Never>? for cancellation support
Step 12: Implement init(installationService:onboardingStore:analytics:) with dependency injection
Step 13: Implement startScan() that sets state to scanning, awaits service.detectAllCLIs(), updates detectedCLIs, transitions to detected
Step 14: Add error handling in startScan() that transitions to error state with user-friendly message
Step 15: Implement installSelected() that validates selectedCLIs non-empty, creates installTask, processes queue sequentially
Step 16: In installSelected() loop, check for task cancellation between installations
Step 17: Update currentProgress during each installation step via service callbacks
Step 18: Transition to complete state after queue finishes with installed and failed arrays
Step 19: Implement installAll() that filters detectedCLIs for not installed, populates selectedCLIs, calls installSelected()
Step 20: Implement skip() that sets state to skipped, calls analytics.track(onboardingCLISkipped), calls onboardingStore.advanceToNextStep()
Step 21: Implement cancel() that calls installTask?.cancel(), sets installTask to nil, transitions to detected state
Step 22: Implement retry() that checks current state and re-invokes appropriate method (startScan or installSelected)
Step 23: Implement computed var canProceed that checks detectedCLIs contains at least one installed or state is skipped
Step 24: Implement computed var isInstalling that pattern matches state to installing case
Step 25: Implement computed var hasErrors that checks state is error or complete with non-empty failed array
Step 26: Implement toggleSelection(cli:) that adds to selectedCLIs if absent or removes if present
Step 27: Implement selectRecommended() that filters CLIType.allCases by isRecommended and sets selectedCLIs
Step 28: Add telemetry tracking calls at state transition points
Step 29: Add unit tests for all public methods and state transitions
Step 30: Add integration tests verifying ViewModel coordinates with mocked services

ui_states: Scanning: Activity indicator with Detecting installed CLIs message, all buttons disabled
Detected: List of CLIs with checkboxes, Install Selected and Skip buttons enabled
Installing: Progress bar with current CLI name, Cancel button enabled, other buttons disabled
Complete Success: Success checkmark with summary of installed CLIs, Continue button enabled
Complete Partial: Warning icon with list of failed CLIs, Retry Failed and Continue buttons enabled
Error: Error icon with message, Retry and Skip buttons enabled
Skipped: Brief confirmation then auto-advances to next onboarding step
ui_interactions: User taps Install Selected to begin installation of checked CLIs
User taps Install All Missing to install all uninstalled CLIs at once
User taps Skip to proceed without installing any CLIs
User taps Cancel during installation to abort and return to detected state
User taps Retry to re-attempt failed scan or failed installations
User taps checkbox next to CLI name to toggle selection
User taps Select Recommended to auto-select recommended CLIs
ui_copy: Scanning state message: Detecting installed CLIs on your system
Detected state header: CLI Tools Detected
Detected state subheader: Select which tools to install
Installing state format: Installing CLI_NAME step X of Y
Complete success message: All selected CLIs installed successfully
Complete partial message: Some installations failed
Error state message: Unable to detect CLIs. Check your network connection.
Skip confirmation: You can install CLIs later from Settings
edge_cases: EC1: User cancels scan before any results returned transitions to error state with Scan cancelled message
EC2: User cancels installation mid-queue preserves already-installed CLIs in detected results
EC3: All selected CLIs fail installation transitions to complete with empty installed and populated failed arrays
EC4: Network timeout during installation includes timeout details in failure reason
EC5: Disk full during installation captures specific error and suggests cleanup
EC6: User rapidly toggles selection during scan ignores toggles until scan completes
EC7: Service returns empty detection results shows No supported CLIs found message
EC8: Homebrew not installed prompts user to install Homebrew first
EC9: User lacks admin privileges for certain installs shows permission error with instructions
EC10: Background app refresh interrupts installation resumes on app foreground
failure_modes: FM1: CLIInstallationService throws during scan - catch error, transition to error state, log details, show user-friendly message
FM2: Individual CLI install fails but others succeed - continue queue processing, aggregate failures, show summary at end
FM3: Task cancelled during await - check Task.isCancelled after each await, clean up gracefully
FM4: Memory pressure during large installation queue - use autorelease pools, stream progress rather than buffer
FM5: Retain cycle from closure capturing self - use [weak self] in all async closures
FM6: Race condition between cancel and completion - use actor isolation to serialize state transitions
rollback_plan: If CLISetupViewModel causes issues, the OnboardingCLISetupView can fall back to directly calling CLIInstallationService methods synchronously with local state variables. The ViewModel is an organizational layer that can be bypassed without affecting core functionality. Remove ViewModel file and update view to use inline state management.

open_questions: Should ViewModel persist partial installation state to UserDefaults for crash recovery
Should there be a timeout for individual CLI installations

notes: This ViewModel is the central coordinator for the CLI setup flow. It bridges the service layer with the UI layer using reactive bindings. The implementation follows MVVM patterns with dependency injection for testability. Consider extracting state machine logic to a separate type if it grows complex.
verification_steps: Run xcodebuild -scheme Blaze -destination platform=macOS test -only-testing:BlazeTests/CLISetupViewModelTests and verify all tests pass

After scan completes, select a CLI, tap Install Selected, verify progress updates and installation completes
Tap Cancel during installation, verify state returns to detected with partial results preserved
Check Xcode analytics console for telemetry events during flow

risks: Async state transitions may cause race conditions if not properly serialized
Retain cycles from closures capturing self could cause memory leaks
Cancellation may leave system in inconsistent state with partial installations
Complex state machine may have edge cases leading to invalid states
mitigations: Use MainActor isolation to serialize all state mutations on main thread
Use weak self in all async closures and verify with memory profiler
Implement cleanup logic in cancellation path to remove partial artifacts
Add state validation assertions in debug builds to catch invalid transitions
risk_register.blast_radius: Limited to onboarding flow. If ViewModel fails, user can skip CLI setup and install CLIs manually from Settings later. No impact on core session management or chat functionality.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If ViewModel architecture proves problematic, inline state management directly in OnboardingCLISetupView using @State properties and direct service calls. This loses testability but maintains functionality.
